title: Gregged
description: A resource pack that turns Pufferfish into Greg
body: Have you ever thought to yourself "Man, Greg is so awesome and cool! I wish he was in Minecraft..." I know you haven't, but I certainly have! This Resource Pack replaces Pufferfish with Greg in literally EVERYTHING! _(Note for non-American: Gregged currently only changes Pufferfish to Greg in text for American English)_
